findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sign_up" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get a free personal token by email — for MCP clients that can't sign in themselves. Most clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code) sign in to WeCo…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_prices, search_sites, sign_up · Private data: search_sites, sign_up · Public sink: compare_prices, search_sites, sign_up · Destructive: search_sites.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_prices, search_sites, sign_up · Private data: search_sites, sign_up · Public sink: compare_prices, search_sites, sign_up · Destructive: search_sites

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
